title: On the ultraviolet behavior of the invariant charge in quantum electrodynamics
summary: In this paper we study the ultraviolet behavior of the invariant charge in QED. We show that for complex momenta the invariant charge does not have Landau pole singularity. We can define new invariant charge as real part of standard invariant charge. New invariant charge is limited from above and does not have Landau pole singularity. Also we use the $1/N$ perturbation theory for the investigation of the ultraviolet behavior of the invariant charge.
